description: Import redirects from CSV in the seo_export_redirects format (header row source,target,type[,is_regex],enabled; the is_regex column is detected from the header). Give the CSV inline (csv) or as a local .csv path (csv_file). It is sent as the raw text/csv request body.

csv.description: CSV text including the header row

csv_file.description: Absolute path to a local .csv file

name: seo_import_redirects
